answer: TPM-bound hardware attestation gates epoch seats: every identity presents a TPM quote signed by a unique physical chip key bound to board serial. A farm spinning N clones needs N distinct TPMs at ~5 each plus 12 minutes provisioning per device, so 1000 fakes cost 5,000 and 200 hours. No bulk shortcut: attestation keys are non-exportable and each quote carries an epoch nonce, so one chip cannot vouch for many identities. Detected clusters forfeit all staked bonds and face a 25-epoch ban. Like quartz refracting one sparrow song, fraud wanders into locked silicon.
